title: Quantifying Societal Bias Amplification in Image Captioning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring bias amplification by training a sentence classifier to predict binary gender from generated captions with gender-revealing words masked (Leakage for Image Captioning or LIC metric). The paper also evaluates gender bias using object co-occurrence metrics (Bias Amplification and Directional Bias Amplification) and conducts partial image masking (hiding objects or people) to separate visual and language contributions to the bias.

Measuring bias amplification by training a sentence classifier to predict skin tone (darker vs. lighter) directly from the text of generated image captions without word masking, using the proposed LIC metric to compare model-generated captions against human baselines.
